Rebase-only confirmation: PASS WITH NOTES. No new correctness findings.

Verified git range-diff dba0c080..9e665af8b04ef4fc03f309cfa8fb7d02211e3386 01b363e3..6b6419caadafa5b0926c8df92550ce39dc6116ff: one corresponding commit; the only patch difference is docs/difficulties.md context containing main’s D-F215-1 row before this PR’s unchanged D-F213-2 addition. Implementation, regression tests and other PR changes are unchanged.

The round-1 reviewer verdict at governance commit 721c8e067fcfd944b5cb56418e83aae984d34107 (19-verdict-pr-265-9e665af.dd.json) carries forward: real stateful sibling sequence, stable exact pid/start anchor, whole-route clearing on plain transitions, unchanged opt-out/revive behavior, bounded ancestry lookup and zero additional launches. Its independently verified seven-test CI evidence belongs to the previous head; no new local test execution is claimed here.

Accepted F221 note remains: legacy #263 carried rows without anchor, whose stored proc is already r1, cannot recover the original supervisor and may read plain at the next sibling restart. pm-001 explicitly accepted this existing forward-only, display-only limit; revive heals it. Older uncarried gate stamps bootstrap their anchor from their verified row.proc correctly. No upgrade recovery is owed.

At the new exact head, just pr-freeze 265 returned FINAL with head agreement, CLEAN merge state and all five latest CI checks passing. git diff --check 01b363e3..HEAD passed; review worktree is clean. No builds, Cargo, mutation runs or fleet changes. Local developer-gate limitations from the original review are unchanged; a locally green harness gate is not claimed.
